description: The two source traditions assign different lords to the three drekkana portions of a sign, so the divisional-house calculation is not interchangeable.
why_they_differ: The Brihat Jataka candidate reports sign, eleventh-house, and twelfth-house lords; the 1937 Phaladeepika passage reports the sign, fifth-house, and ninth-house lords. The source locators and normalized wording are retained rather than harmonized.
user_facing_note: Choose a school explicitly; do not apply a single drekkana-lord sequence across sources.
